trajectory.content:
I can do this, but I need a few missing items/permissions before I can enroll employees and send notifications. Please provide or confirm the following so I can proceed:

1) Compliance tracker (Google Sheets)
- Spreadsheet name or Spreadsheet ID:
- Worksheet/tab name where enrollments should be recorded:
- Worksheet/tab name that lists training sessions/schedule (if separate):

2) Source of employees to enroll
- Should I enroll:
  - everyone listed in the tracker, or
  - only employees flagged as "Due" / "Not Enrolled" / another status? If the latter, tell me the exact status value(s) to match (preserve value verbatim).
- If you want me to pull employees from BambooHR instead of the sheet, confirm and provide API access or account details (or confirm I already have access).

3) Training session mapping rules
- How to choose the "correct session" for each person (e.g., by Department, Location, Job Title, or a column in the tracker named exactly X). List exact column names/values if applicable (verbatim).

4) Notifications
- Sender email to use for Gmail (e.g., training@company.com) or confirm default.
- Email subject template (or OK to use: "Required Compliance Training — Session Assigned").
- Slack channel to post enrollment notifications (e.g., #compliance). If you want a DM to each user instead, confirm.

5) Tracker update details
- Which columns to update after enrollment (e.g., "Status", "Session Date", "Session Time", "Enrolled On", "Enrolled By") — provide exact column names (verbatim).
- Exact status value to write for completed enrollment (verbatim), e.g., "Enrolled".

6) Timing / checks before enrolling
- Where schedule changes / department updates are stored (a sheet, BambooHR fields, or another source). If BambooHR, confirm I should check employee.department or another field (give exact field name).
- If I find a schedule change/department update that affects session assignment, how should I proceed? (auto-reassign with new session, or flag for review with status value X).

If you prefer defaults, confirm I should:
- Use a sheet named "Compliance Training Tracker" in My Drive with tabs "Enrollments" and "Training Schedule";
- Enroll employees whose Tracker "Status" equals "Due";
- Choose sessions by matching the Tracker "Department" to Training Schedule "Department";
- Send email from training@company.com with subject "Required Compliance Training — Session Assigned";
- Update the Tracker "Status" to "Enrolled" and add "Session Date" and "Session Time" verbatim from the Training Schedule;
- Post a summary message to Slack channel #compliance.

Once you confirm or give the requested IDs/access, I will:
- Check for schedule changes and department updates (BambooHR and the schedule sheet);
- Enroll each person in the correct session;
- Send each person a Gmail with date/time (preserving values verbatim);
- Update the tracker row(s) with the enrollment information and status;
- Post a summary to Slack with the enrollments performed.

Which option do you want (provide details or confirm defaults)?
